The bank failed to maintain an effective AML program from January 2014 to October 2023, with 92% of transaction volume going unmonitored (~$18.3 trillion), enabling three money laundering networks to transfer more than $670 million through TD Bank accounts.
judge_reason: Sources confirm the October 2024 guilty pleas by TD Bank, N.A. and TD Bank US Holding Company, the $1.8 billion DOJ penalty, nearly $3.1 billion total resolution, AML failures from 2014-2023, 92% unmonitored volume, and $670 million laundered.

judge_reason: FinCEN release confirms record $1.3B penalty and Sze CTR/SAR failures.
